question: A17
reason: Every reach-in (auditme.core, auditme.registry, auditme.phaseb, auditme.rules.project_hygiene from audit.py, changed.py and phaseb.py) names a public owning module: auditme and auditme.rules have no __all__ and none of these submodules has a leading underscore.

surface: __all__ exports Candidate, Lister, MergeResult, TestRef, Verdict, architecture, build_test_map, question_kinds and register_question, but no code outside auditme/phaseb/ and outside the test tree reads any of them, and no literal getattr, importlib.import_module or entry point does either (only tests use them; architecture.py registers its listers via candidates.register_question, not the package surface): drop them from __all__ (keep the `architecture` import for its registration side effect), or give the tests a documented test surface instead of the public one.
